text_en: Look how well they light up the library with their eerie glow.
It's simply fantastic that you've managed to find fifteen subjects for our test.
Thanks to your efforts and the essence extracted from these creatures, I've managed to create a formula.
To be quite honest, this is the first time I've tried to potion like this one, so one of two things could happen to you: either it works, or you die.
You think that smile on my face means I'm joking, don't you?
